data.body: S5 PS4 pushed to Gerrit 2316. Blocking LLM-Review finding (process-global CrossSessionWarning filter in build_server) FIXED: removed the global filterwarnings; added suppress_library_double_advisory(mcp) proxy in _lib_warn.py wrapping read/write registrars so each handler runs under the scoped suppress_cross_session_warning() ContextVar guard (sync+async via functools.wraps, delegates other attrs via __getattr__). Real build_server() builds 61 tools schemas intact incl async run_workflow. RED-first: 2 new held-out tests red vs global filter, green after fix. make lint+typecheck green; 141 targeted tests pass; mcp_server.py 797/800 LOC. Awaiting LLM-Review+1 + Verified+1.
